'''Dantin Vellos''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Vellos became the leader of a mercenary group and commanded the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Taznak Pajiic]], the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Sinbbis]] and the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Ajalo Nills]]. When the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] was scheduled and [[Osten Dal'Nay]], the leader of the [[Cularin Militia]] planned to use the event to publicize the activities that the [[Thaereian military]] was pursuing in the system. The Thaereians responded by hiring Vellos, and his mercenaries, to kill Dal'Nay. After the podrace was held, the spectators traveled to the village of [[Tathin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and Vellos contacted Dal'Nay, claiming to be a potential benefactor for the Militia. Dal'Nay went to meet with Vellos, who had arranged an ambush and had his mercenaries throw some [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]] at Dal'Nay. However, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] survived and fled into the Cularin jungle. Vellos pursued and he and his mercenaries attacked a pair of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] botanists who they passed. Eventually, the mercenaries trapped Dal'Nay at a shallow stream and attacked him with melee weapons, because they believed that the noise from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire would draw too much attention to them. However, the [[heroes of Cularin]] suddenly arrived and they defeated Vellos and his mercenaries.
